title: How does GPS work? How your phone knows where you are
caption:
How does GPS work? Your phone finds you using clocks in space, and it never talks back. It only listens.
The twist: those clocks run 38 millionths of a second fast every day. In 1977, a test satellite flew with the fix off.
Did you think your phone sends its location up to the satellites?
